diagnostics.coldStart: Cold start — the cache expired and needs to be re-primed.
diagnostics.compacted: Context compaction ran — the cache prefix is being re-primed.
diagnostics.visionFallback: {{model}} cannot handle images — trying a vision-capable model.
diagnostics.visionDemoted: No vision model available — screenshots demoted to text stubs. Set a Vision fallback (e.g. Gemini) under Settings → Agent for full computer use.
diagnostics.resumedTurn: Resuming interrupted agent turn from the last checkpoint…
diagnostics.partialPreserved: _(Stream interrupted on {{model}} — partial reply preserved. Retrying…)_

errors.noProvider: No provider or model configured. Open Settings → Providers, then Settings → Models.
errors.allAttemptsFailed: All model attempts failed. Last error: {{error}}
errors.noUsableModel: No usable model. Check that a provider is enabled and has models attached.
errors.noVisionModel: This turn needs images, but no vision-capable model is available. In Settings → Models mark Gemini/GPT-4o/Claude as Vision, enable its provider, and set Vision fallback under Settings → Agent.
errors.noVisionFallbackDisabled: Vision fallback model is disabled. Re-enable it under Settings → Models, or pick another Vision model in Settings → Agent.
errors.noVisionFallbackProvider: Vision fallback model’s provider is off or missing. Enable the Google/OpenAI/Claude provider under Settings → Providers.
errors.toolLoop: Tool loop detected: repeated the same calls ({{names}}) {{rounds}} rounds without progress. Stopping.
errors.maxRounds: Stopped after {{rounds}} tool rounds without a final answer.
errors.emptyResponse: The model returned an empty reply. Try again, or switch to a stronger model. (Gmail send is not supported — Google is connected for read-only tools only.)
errors.sessionBudgetHit: Stopped: session spend reached ${{cost}} (cap ${{cap}}). Raise the limit under Settings → Usage, or start a new session.
errors.dailyBudgetHit: Stopped: today's spend reached ${{cost}} (cap ${{cap}}). Raise the limit under Settings → Usage.

permission.allowSessionHint: Approve every request of this type until the app restarts

appearanceSection.title: Appearance
appearanceSection.desc: Customize how Pawn looks and feels
appearanceSection.themeDesc: Choose between light, dark, or system theme

providerSection.title: Providers
providerSection.name: Name
providerSection.presetDesc: Well-known providers — paste an API key and go. Model lists refresh from each provider’s API when possible.
providerSection.hintBailian: bailian.console.aliyun.com — issue an API key on the Token Plan page
providerSection.hintOllama: Local server — no API key needed, Ollama must be running
providerSection.hintLmStudio: Local server — no API key needed, LM Studio must be running
providerSection.syncHint: Fetch the live model catalog from GET {baseUrl}/models and merge it into your list

modelSection.title: Models
modelSection.desc: Manage available models. Prefer Sync models on a provider so the list comes from their API instead of stale seeds. Mark vision capability so text-only models can fall back automatically.
modelSection.pricingDesc: Pricing (USD / 1M tokens) — used for router cost math and cache savings. Leave blank if unknown.
modelSection.visionHint: Yes = can see attached images/screenshots. No = text only (router will fall back). Auto = guess from the model id.

agentSection.title: Agent
agentSection.desc: Routing, permissions, and shell safety for the main agent
agentSection.routingDesc: Automatically route tasks to the best available model
agentSection.visionFallbackDesc: Optional. Used only when the active model cannot handle images (attachments or screenshots). If your main model already has vision (e.g. Gemini), leave this on Auto — nothing extra is needed.
agentSection.visionFallbackEmpty: No vision-capable models yet. Add one under Models and set Vision to Yes (or use a Gemini/GPT-4o/Claude preset).
agentSection.sendModeDesc: Choose how messages are sent to the agent
agentSection.permissionModeDesc: Control how the agent asks for permissions
agentSection.shellSandboxDesc: Env allowlist + dangerous-command block for agent shell_exec (default on)
agentSection.shellNetworkDesc: Allow network in sandboxed shells (off uses sandbox-exec on macOS when possible)
agentSection.cwdJailDesc: Refuse shell cwd outside the project root
agentSection.autoMemoryConsolidateDesc: Merge near-duplicate memory cards after each turn

agentsSection.title: Subagents
agentsSection.desc: Build specialized helpers the main chat can hand work off to—research, planning, implementation, review, and more. Pawn ships with ready-made roles; yours are saved with the project or on this device.
agentsSection.customEmpty: No custom agents yet. Tap “New agent”, or copy a built-in role and tweak it.
agentsSection.fieldNameHint: Lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens. Stored as a small file under .pawn/agents.
agentsSection.fieldDescriptionPh: When should the main chat pick this agent?
agentsSection.fieldToolsHint: Comma-separated tool names. Leave empty to allow the usual set (minus anything you deny below).
agentsSection.fieldSkillsHint: Comma-separated skill names. Their guides are loaded for this agent only.
agentsSection.fieldPathAllowHint: Only these paths may be edited (e.g. src/**). Leave empty to allow anything not blocked below.
agentsSection.fieldPathDenyHint: Never touch these paths (e.g. .env, secrets folders).
agentsSection.maxParallelDesc: How many helpers can work side by side. Extra jobs wait their turn.
agentsSection.autoOpenPanelDesc: Open the side panel when helpers start, so you can watch progress live.
agentsSection.errNoProject: Open a project to save for this project, or choose “This device”.
agentsSection.errDeleteClaude: You can edit Claude Code agents here, but only Pawn-saved agents can be deleted from this screen.
agentsSection.costModeDesc: Default model budget when helpers run. A stronger model set on a specific agent still wins.
agentsSection.costFrugalDesc: Prefer cheaper models. Research stays light; implementers may use a mid-tier model. No automatic upgrades.
agentsSection.costBalancedDesc: Recommended. Light research, mid-tier planning/review, freer choice for implementers—within safe bounds.
agentsSection.costQualityDesc: Use the best available model when it helps. Still reuses cached context to limit cost when possible.
agentsSection.parallelHint: When work can be split up, Pawn can run several helpers at the same time (up to six) so independent tasks finish faster. Watch them in the Agents panel.

hooksSection.title: Hooks
hooksSection.desc: Run scripts at agent lifecycle points (Claude/Codex-compatible). Sources merge with dedupe so the same command is not run twice. PreToolUse deny wins even in YOLO.
hooksSection.enabledDesc: Fire lifecycle hooks from Claude and Pawn config files
hooksSection.empty: No hooks found. Add them under ~/.claude/settings.json or ~/.pawn/hooks.json.
hooksSection.desktopOnly: Hooks run in the desktop app.

memorySection.title: Memory (self-learning)
memorySection.desc: Long-term knowledge on this device only. When on, the agent learns preferences and project facts, recalls them automatically, and never stores API keys or passwords.
memorySection.enabledDesc: Learn from chats, recall on later turns — no extra setup
memorySection.autoCaptureDesc: After each chat turn, save durable preferences and project facts
memorySection.injectOnTurnDesc: Add matching memories into the prompt so the agent can use them
memorySection.clearConfirm: Delete every memory on this device? This cannot be undone.
memorySection.empty: Nothing yet. Chat normally, or say “remember this…”.
memorySection.desktopOnly: Memory is available in the desktop app.

mcpSection.title: MCP
mcpSection.desc: MCP servers configured for this device, added through Pawn, or scoped to this project — the agent can call their tools alongside its built-in ones.

source.project: Added in Pawn · this project only

mcpSection.hint: Servers from ~/.claude.json are read-only here — manage those with Claude Code. Servers you add below live in Pawn's own config and can be edited or removed anytime.
mcpSection.noProjectForScope: Open a project to add a project-scoped server.
mcpSection.envPlaceholder: Environment variables, one per line: KEY=value

dataSection.title: Data
dataSection.exportDesc: Export all settings and configuration to a file
dataSection.importDesc: Import settings from a previously exported file
dataSection.exportKeyNote: API keys are not exported; re-enter keys after import.
dataSection.configFileDesc: View and edit the raw configuration file
dataSection.fullBackupDesc: Zip ~/.pawn (config, chats DB, memory). API keys in config.json are included — store the zip safely.
dataSection.importEmpty: No providers or models found in that file
dataSection.restoreConfirm: Restore will replace local Pawn data (~/.pawn). A copy of the current folder is kept. Restart Pawn after restore. Continue?
dataSection.restoreOk: Restored. Previous data saved at {{path}}. Please restart Pawn.
dataSection.keysEncrypted: API keys are encrypted at rest with the OS keychain when available.

connectionsSection.title: Service connections
connectionsSection.desc: Optionally link Google, GitHub, GitLab (self-hosted), or AWS CodeCommit so the agent can access your data on this machine. Tokens stay local — never sent to Pawn servers.
connectionsSection.statusConnectedDesc: Signed in. Tokens are stored only on this device.
connectionsSection.statusDisconnected: Not connected — click Connect to sign in
connectionsSection.statusDisconnectedPat: Not connected — paste a token / credentials to connect
connectionsSection.desktopOnly: Service connections are only available in the desktop app.
connectionsSection.deviceHint: Open {{uri}} and enter the code below (not a 2FA code).
connectionsSection.gitlabPatHint: Works with gitlab.com or self-hosted GitLab. Create a PAT with api (or read_api) scope under User Settings → Access Tokens.
connectionsSection.codecommitPatHint: CodeCommit has no browser OAuth — paste an IAM access key with codecommit permissions. Optional session token for temporary credentials.
connectionsSection.privacyNote: Sign-in tokens and secrets are stored only under ~/.pawn on this machine. They are not uploaded or shared with other services.

automationSection.title: Automations
automationSection.desc: Recurring tasks that run in the background while the app is open.
automationSection.addDesc: The prompt runs automatically in a dedicated session.
automationSection.empty: No automations yet. Create one above.

systemSection.title: System
systemSection.sleepPreventionDesc: Keep the system awake while the app runs. Display mode also prevents the screen from turning off.
systemSection.trayEnabledDesc: Keep a Pawn icon in the system tray / menu bar (right-click for menu)
systemSection.taskNotificationsDesc: Show a notification once when a turn finishes (chat replies and coding work) while Pawn is in the background.
systemSection.confirmQuitDesc: Ask for confirmation when quitting with ⌘Q / Ctrl+Q or the tray Quit item. You can also uncheck “Don’t ask again” on the quit dialog.
systemSection.checkUpdatesOnLaunchDesc: Quietly compare with GitHub Releases when Pawn starts
systemSection.checkUpdatesDesc: Compare this build with the latest GitHub release

shortcutSection.title: Shortcuts
shortcutSection.desc: Rebind keyboard shortcuts. Click Change, then press the new combination.

usageSection.dailyBudgetDesc: Soft-stop when today’s on-device usage reaches the cap. 0 = unlimited.
